description: Actual second full image: single upright young man with short sandy textured crop/shorn sides and pointed golden chin beard with connected moustache, cheeks mostly bare, hair margin, visible hands and brown boots. Navy long embroidered noble coat with restrained fur edges/cuffs, cream embroidered shirt, ornate belt, brown trousers. Plain stone doorway, no text, banner, headgear, armour or weapons; natural medium body.
